searchText: Hi guys! I'm trying to catch up on the SSV state of affairs - I understand that Blox will be leading the work and project management on the official spec and implementation with a target go-live timeline for Q1/Q2. Where could I find the official spec and is the current implementation repo public? Hi! We are working on the official spec (could use all the help we can get) The repo is this one: https://github.com/bloxapp/ssv Thanks a lot 🙂
